citations.assessment: At the teaching on instructing one’s children, the Wikisource transcription reads עקביא and Sefaria’s vocalized text reads עקיבה. Both support this exact locus.

citations.assessment: The corresponding Yalkut passage explicitly reads Yose ben Akiva.
The Isi article documents the alternate patronymics Akavya and Akiva. Heilprin proposes the correction here without establishing an identity.

holds.reason: The checked Sifrei and Yalkut witnesses read Yose. The Isi substitution remains Heilprin’s conjecture.
